name: sattva
displayName: Sattva — intent-first workflow for Claude Code
description: Intent-first workflow sized to the change: S (just do it and check), M (short plan with Risks), L (intent → plan → independent check → implement → verify). Built on Anthropic's AI-native SDLC playbook and Claude Code best practices; the plan is the spec.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language of the Sattva band, buttons and toasts. auto follows Claude Code's language setting; missing translations fall back to English.

feedback.title: Agent feedback
feedback.description: Chain skills write a short self-report on the skill text, a judge checks it; stored only on this machine in ~/.claude/sattva-feedback. /sattva:feedback shows the summary.

panel.title: Side panel
panel.description: The Sattva panel beside the chat (Desktop): what waits for you, child sessions, plan, checks, cost. Reads only; /sattva-panel opens it.
